nodes.name: List Source Files
nodes.notes:
Replace with your file source. Options:
- Read files from a local directory
- HTTP Request to fetch from a remote API
- Google Drive, S3, or other cloud storage nodes

nodes.name: Hash & Dedup Check
nodes.notes: Computes SHA-256 hash, checks workflow static data, and optimistically stores new hashes before ingestion.

nodes.name: Is New Document?
nodes.notes: Routes new documents to ingestion, skips already-processed ones.

nodes.name: Track Poll Count
nodes.notes: Limits polling to 60 iterations (5 minutes). Changes status to 'timeout' when exceeded.
